summary: @onereach/step-voice preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle on install
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases if `bun` is not already on PATH, extracts and chmods it, then executes `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle using a rotated string-array scheme with hex-named identifiers (`WV8StW`, `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`,...) and char-code reassembly, unrelated to the package's stated 'Voice Steps' purpose. Installing the package causes an alternate JavaScript runtime to be fetched and used specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload on the installer's machine, which Node-focused review and scanning tooling cannot inspect. The combination of alternate-runtime dropper, mismatch between advertised purpose and executed payload, and heavy obfuscation of the executed body constitutes install-time execution of unreviewable code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
